locked.pitch: Reply to Instagram comments with an automatic DM: keyword in the comment, message (with link buttons) in the follower's inbox.
locked.cardKeyword: A keyword in the comment triggers the DM
locked.cardButtons: Up to 3 link buttons in the message

tour.step1Text: Every automation starts with this button. We will open the form for you and walk through each field.
tour.step2Text: This name is only visible to your team. Use something that identifies the campaign, like "Ebook launch".
tour.step3Text: Only clients with a connected Instagram account appear here. If someone is missing, connect their account in the client's Social networks tab.
tour.step4Text: All posts replies to comments on any publication. Specific post lets you pick a post in production or one already published.
tour.step5Text: When a comment contains one of them, the automation fires. Type and press Enter. E.g. "I want it", "link".
tour.step6Text: This is what the person receives in their inbox. The preview on the side shows how it looks on Instagram.
tour.step7Text: Optional: up to 3 buttons take the person to your site, checkout or material. With buttons, the message can have up to 640 characters.
tour.step8Title: Reply to the comment and save
tour.step8Text: The public reply is optional and shows the profile is active. Done: review and tap Save to activate.
